integrity: Analytical formulas, proofs and independently evaluated numerical representations are included; no claim of independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: Applicable only to independent unbiased two-state Poisson-flipping particles with a step-density thermodynamic limit. Cumulants are disorder averages of conditional cumulants; the sign-crossing need not be unique. Original generating functions are prior work; independent publication-priority review is outstanding.
title: A preparation-induced third-current-cumulant reversal in a run-and-tumble gas
